picture.alt: A sunny club fair on a university campus: tents in blue, orange, green and red, students walking between them, trees and brick buildings behind. Two young men with backpacks stand in front. On the left, under a blue tent, an acoustic guitar stands on a black stand next to a table with a red cloth; nobody is holding it. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers stands near it with his hands in his pockets, leaning forward and looking right, at the next table. On the right, at a table with a blue cloth, a young man with wavy brown shoulder-length hair, a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt, dark green trousers and a white backpack holds a calligraphy brush up in his right hand and looks down at a sheet of white paper held by a wooden weight, his left hand resting on the table; a pot of brushes and an ink stone stand on the table. Far behind him on the right, people in black clothes do kung fu on a red carpet.

picture.alt: A bright children's room with big windows, green plants, shelves of books and toys and a picture of a yellow flower on the wall. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt sits at a table between two small boys, smiling, and holds out a blue crayon to the boy on the right, who reaches for it. The boy on the left has curly brown hair and an orange T-shirt and draws with a red crayon on a picture with a yellow sun and green trees. A box of crayons and a cup of crayons stand on the table. Nobody is reading. In the back, a woman with reddish-brown hair and a green apron works at a table.

lines.english: Don't read too much into it! Your skills are the best in the club, so of course everyone asks you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那她為什麼每次都坐在我旁邊？
lines.simplified: 那她为什么每次都坐在我旁边？

lines.speaker: M

lines.english: It's fine. I can sleep on the bus.

text.traditional:
時間：9月18日到22日（星期一到星期五）早上10點到下午4點
活動：鋼琴社、吉他社、書法社、功夫社等二十個社團都會在圖書館前面擺攤子，社員會給大家介紹自己的社團。
表演：9月20日（星期三）中午12點，功夫社表演中國功夫
注意：想參加社團，請在攤子上寫你的名字跟電話。一個人只能參加三個社團。每天最早來的五十位同學，可以拿到一張明信片。
text.simplified:
时间：9月18日到22日（星期一到星期五）早上10点到下午4点
活动：钢琴社、吉他社、书法社、功夫社等二十个社团都会在图书馆前面摆摊子，社员会给大家介绍自己的社团。
表演：9月20日（星期三）中午12点，功夫社表演中国功夫
注意：想参加社团，请在摊子上写你的名字跟电话。一个人只能参加三个社团。每天最早来的五十位同学，可以拿到一张明信片。
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: Jiǔ yuè shíbā rì dào èrshí'èr rì (xīngqíyī dào xīngqíwǔ) zǎoshàng shí diǎn dào xiàwǔ sì diǎn
Huódòng: Gāngqín shè, jítā shè, shūfǎ shè, gōngfu shè děng èrshí ge shètuán dōu huì zài túshūguǎn qiánmiàn bǎi tānzi, shèyuán huì gěi dàjiā jièshào zìjǐ de shètuán.
Biǎoyǎn: Jiǔ yuè èrshí rì (xīngqísān) zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, gōngfu shè biǎoyǎn Zhōngguó gōngfu
Zhùyì: Xiǎng cānjiā shètuán, qǐng zài tānzi shàng xiě nǐ de míngzi gēn diànhuà. Yí ge rén zhǐ néng cānjiā sān ge shètuán. Měi tiān zuì zǎo lái de wǔshí wèi tóngxué, kěyǐ ná dào yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn.
text.english:
Time: September 18–22 (Monday to Friday), 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
What: twenty clubs, including the piano, guitar, calligraphy and kung fu clubs, will set up stalls in front of the library, and their members will tell you about their clubs.
Show: September 20 (Wednesday) at noon, the kung fu club performs Chinese kung fu
Note: to join a club, write your name and phone number at its stall. Each person may join only three clubs. The first fifty students each day get a postcard.

passage.traditional: 開學第一個星期，圖書館前面{1}了很多社團的攤子。我把攤子都看了一遍，最後選擇了吉他社，{2}我的室友上個學期就參加了，我們可以一起去練習。第一次去練習的時候，教室裡{3}著二十幾個社員，大家都很客氣。我旁邊的男生教了我很多技巧，我們聊了一下，才知道他跟我是{4}一個系的。{5}他只比我大一歲，可是吉他學得比我好多了。
passage.simplified: 开学第一个星期，图书馆前面{1}了很多社团的摊子。我把摊子都看了一遍，最后选择了吉他社，{2}我的室友上个学期就参加了，我们可以一起去练习。第一次去练习的时候，教室里{3}着二十几个社员，大家都很客气。我旁边的男生教了我很多技巧，我们聊了一下，才知道他跟我是{4}一个系的。{5}他只比我大一岁，可是吉他学得比我好多了。
passage.pinyin: Kāixué dì yī ge xīngqí, túshūguǎn qiánmiàn bǎi le hěn duō shètuán de tānzi. Wǒ bǎ tānzi dōu kàn le yí biàn, zuìhòu xuǎnzé le jítā shè, yīnwèi wǒ de shìyǒu shàng ge xuéqí jiù cānjiā le, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù liànxí. Dì yī cì qù liànxí de shíhòu, jiàoshì lǐ zuò zhe èrshí jǐ ge shèyuán, dàjiā dōu hěn kèqì. Wǒ pángbiān de nánshēng jiāo le wǒ hěn duō jìqiǎo, wǒmen liáo le yíxià, cái zhīdào tā gēn wǒ shì tóng yí ge xì de. Suīrán tā zhǐ bǐ wǒ dà yí suì, kěshì jítā xué de bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le.
passage.english: In the first week of the semester, lots of club stalls were set up in front of the library. I went round all of them once and in the end chose the guitar club, because my roommate joined it last semester, so we could go to practice together. At my first practice, twenty-odd members were sitting in the classroom, all very friendly. The young man next to me taught me a lot of technique; we chatted a bit and only then found out that he and I are in the same department. Although he is only a year older than me, he plays far better than I do.

questions.why: Place + 擺了 + N: stalls are things that are set out (擺). 站 and 躺 are for people, and stalls are not stuck up (貼) like posters.
The roommate joining last semester is the reason for choosing the guitar club, so 因為. 所以 and 然後 would put last semester after this choice, and 除了 needs 還／也 after it.
Place + 坐著 + people: for people the verb shows their posture (坐). 放, 掛 and 停 say how things or cars are placed, not people.
跟……是同一個系的: two people in the same department. 各一個, 每一個 and 哪一個 can't name what two people share.
雖然……，可是……: only a year older, but much better at guitar. 可是 needs 雖然 in the first half; 不但 pairs with 而且, 為了 needs a goal, and 只要 needs 就.

passage.traditional: 上個週末天氣很好，愛心服務社{1}我們去安養院服務。安養院門口{2}著一張海報，上面寫著「歡迎大家來服務」。我們先幫老人打掃環境，再陪他們聊天。有一位老先生說，他年輕的時候跟我爸爸在{3}一家公司上班！我聽了，{4}打電話告訴爸爸，爸爸聽了也很高興。這次服務{5}讓我幫助了別人，而且讓我認識了一位新朋友。
passage.simplified: 上个周末天气很好，爱心服务社{1}我们去安养院服务。安养院门口{2}着一张海报，上面写着「欢迎大家来服务」。我们先帮老人打扫环境，再陪他们聊天。有一位老先生说，他年轻的时候跟我爸爸在{3}一家公司上班！我听了，{4}打电话告诉爸爸，爸爸听了也很高兴。这次服务{5}让我帮助了别人，而且让我认识了一位新朋友。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò tiānqì hěn hǎo, àixīn fúwù shè ānpái wǒmen qù ānyǎng yuàn fúwù. Ānyǎng yuàn ménkǒu tiē zhe yì zhāng hǎibào, shàngmiàn xiě zhe “Huānyíng dàjiā lái fúwù”. Wǒmen xiān bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng, zài péi tāmen liáotiān. Yǒu yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng shuō, tā niánqīng de shíhòu gēn wǒ bàba zài tóng yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān! Wǒ tīng le, lìkè dǎ diànhuà gàosu bàba, bàba tīng le yě hěn gāoxìng. Zhè cì fúwù búdàn ràng wǒ bāngzhù le biérén, érqiě ràng wǒ rènshì le yí wèi xīn péngyǒu.
passage.english: Last weekend the weather was lovely, and the volunteer service club arranged for us to help at a nursing home. A poster was stuck up at its entrance, saying "Everyone is welcome to come and help". First we cleaned up for the old people, then we chatted with them. One old man said that when he was young he worked at the same company as my dad! When I heard that, I called my dad right away, and he was very happy to hear it too. This visit not only let me help others but also let me make a new friend.

questions.why: 社團安排我們去……服務: the club arranges for its members to go and help. 照顧, 處理 and 檢查 take something to look after, deal with or check, so they can't be followed by 我們去 + a place.
Place + 貼著 + 海報: a poster is stuck (貼) at the entrance. 坐 and 站 are for people, and 穿 is for clothes.
跟我爸爸在同一家公司上班: worked at the same company as my dad. 各一家, 每一家 and 哪一家 can't name the one company two people share.
我聽了，立刻打電話: hearing the news, I called Dad right away. 互相 needs two sides doing it to each other, 本來 needs a later change, and 從小 can't describe one reaction to news.
不但……，而且……: not only helped others but also made a friend. 而且 adds a second good thing, so it pairs with 不但, not with 雖然, 因為 or 只要.

text.traditional: 這學期我修了一門美術課，每個星期三下午上課，教我們的是一位美術系的老師。第一次上課，老師在桌上放了一個蘋果，要我們畫畫看。我覺得太簡單了，十分鐘就畫完了。老師看了以後說：「你只看了一下就開始畫，所以畫得一點都不像。」她要我們先看蘋果看二十分鐘，再開始畫。我這才發現，一個蘋果上有紅色、黃色，還有一點綠色。以前我只重視畫得快不快，從這次上課中，我學到了做事別太急，先看清楚了再做，常常會做得更好。
text.simplified: 这学期我修了一门美术课，每个星期三下午上课，教我们的是一位美术系的老师。第一次上课，老师在桌上放了一个苹果，要我们画画看。我觉得太简单了，十分钟就画完了。老师看了以后说：「你只看了一下就开始画，所以画得一点都不像。」她要我们先看苹果看二十分钟，再开始画。我这才发现，一个苹果上有红色、黄色，还有一点绿色。以前我只重视画得快不快，从这次上课中，我学到了做事别太急，先看清楚了再做，常常会做得更好。
text.pinyin: Zhè xuéqí wǒ xiū le yì mén měishù kè, měi ge xīngqísān xiàwǔ shàngkè, jiāo wǒmen de shì yí wèi měishù xì de lǎoshī. Dì yī cì shàngkè, lǎoshī zài zhuō shàng fàng le yí ge píngguǒ, yào wǒmen huà huà kàn. Wǒ juéde tài jiǎndān le, shí fēnzhōng jiù huà wán le. Lǎoshī kàn le yǐhòu shuō: “Nǐ zhǐ kàn le yíxià jiù kāishǐ huà, suǒyǐ huà de yìdiǎn dōu bú xiàng.” Tā yào wǒmen xiān kàn píngguǒ kàn èrshí fēnzhōng, zài kāishǐ huà. Wǒ zhè cái fāxiàn, yí ge píngguǒ shàng yǒu hóngsè, huángsè, hái yǒu yìdiǎn lǜsè. Yǐqián wǒ zhǐ zhòngshì huà de kuài bú kuài, cóng zhè cì shàngkè zhōng, wǒ xué dào le zuòshì bié tài jí, xiān kàn qīngchǔ le zài zuò, chángcháng huì zuò de gèng hǎo.
text.english: This semester I'm taking an art course. It meets every Wednesday afternoon and is taught by a teacher from the fine arts department. In the first class, the teacher put an apple on the table and had us try drawing it. I thought it was too easy and finished in ten minutes. The teacher looked at it and said, "You only glanced at it before you started drawing, so it doesn't look like it at all." She had us look at the apple for twenty minutes before starting. Only then did I notice that one apple has red, yellow and even a little green on it. I used to care only about drawing fast; from this class I learned not to rush: look carefully first, then act, and you often do better.

prompt.traditional: 第一次上課，這個人一開始覺得畫蘋果怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 第一次上课，这个人一开始觉得画苹果怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī cì shàngkè, zhège rén yìkāishǐ juéde huà píngguǒ zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: In the first class, what did the writer think of drawing the apple at first?

questions.why: 我覺得太簡單了，十分鐘就畫完了: at first the writer thought it was easy. It took only ten minutes, and the passage says nothing about finding it hard or interesting.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人從這次上課中學到了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人从这次上课中学到了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén cóng zhè cì shàngkè zhōng xué dào le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer learn from this class?

choices.pinyin: Duō liànxí jiù néng huà de hǎo.
choices.english: Practise more and you will draw well.

choices.pinyin: Huàhuà yào xiān xuǎn hǎo yánsè.
choices.english: Choose your colours before you draw.

choices.pinyin: Zuò de kuài bù yídìng zuò de hǎo.
choices.english: Doing something fast doesn't mean doing it well.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo lǎoshī néng ràng rén jìnbù.
choices.english: A good teacher helps you improve.

questions.why: 以前我只重視畫得快不快，從這次上課中，我學到了做事別太急: the writer used to care only about speed and learned that rushing doesn't give good work. The passage never says practice, choosing colours first or the teacher is the lesson.

text.traditional: 上個學期，我參加了學校的愛心服務社。社團每個月安排兩次活動，我最喜歡的是去育幼院。第一次去的時候，我想教孩子唱歌，可是他們都玩自己的，不聽我的話，我急得快哭了。一位老師告訴我：「妳先陪他們玩，等他們跟妳熟了，就會聽妳的話了。」後來，我每次去都先陪孩子玩半個小時，再教他們刷牙、穿衣服。現在那些孩子一看到我，就跑過來叫我「姐姐」。從這些經驗中，我知道了想讓別人聽你的話，得先讓他們喜歡你。這是課本上學不到的，對我來說非常寶貴。
text.simplified: 上个学期，我参加了学校的爱心服务社。社团每个月安排两次活动，我最喜欢的是去育幼院。第一次去的时候，我想教孩子唱歌，可是他们都玩自己的，不听我的话，我急得快哭了。一位老师告诉我：「你先陪他们玩，等他们跟你熟了，就会听你的话了。」后来，我每次去都先陪孩子玩半个小时，再教他们刷牙、穿衣服。现在那些孩子一看到我，就跑过来叫我「姐姐」。从这些经验中，我知道了想让别人听你的话，得先让他们喜欢你。这是课本上学不到的，对我来说非常宝贵。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xuéqí, wǒ cānjiā le xuéxiào de àixīn fúwù shè. Shètuán měi ge yuè ānpái liǎng cì huódòng, wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shì qù yùyòuyuàn. Dì yī cì qù de shíhòu, wǒ xiǎng jiāo háizi chànggē, kěshì tāmen dōu wán zìjǐ de, bù tīng wǒ de huà, wǒ jí de kuài kū le. Yí wèi lǎoshī gàosu wǒ: “Nǐ xiān péi tāmen wán, děng tāmen gēn nǐ shóu le, jiù huì tīng nǐ de huà le.” Hòulái, wǒ měi cì qù dōu xiān péi háizi wán bàn ge xiǎoshí, zài jiāo tāmen shuāyá, chuān yīfu. Xiànzài nàxiē háizi yí kàn dào wǒ, jiù pǎo guòlái jiào wǒ “jiějie”. Cóng zhèxiē jīngyàn zhōng, wǒ zhīdào le xiǎng ràng biérén tīng nǐ de huà, děi xiān ràng tāmen xǐhuān nǐ. Zhè shì kèběn shàng xué bú dào de, duì wǒ lái shuō fēicháng bǎoguì.
text.english: Last semester I joined the school's volunteer service club. The club arranges two outings a month, and my favourite is the orphanage. The first time I went, I wanted to teach the children a song, but they all played on their own and wouldn't listen to me; I was so upset I nearly cried. A teacher told me, "Play with them first. Once they know you, they'll listen to you." After that, every time I went I first played with the children for half an hour, then taught them to brush their teeth and get dressed. Now as soon as those children see me, they run over and call me "big sister". From these experiences I learned that if you want people to listen to you, you first have to make them like you. You can't learn that from a textbook, and to me it is very precious.

prompt.traditional: 第一次去育幼院的時候，她本來想做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 第一次去育幼院的时候，她本来想做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī cì qù yùyòuyuàn de shíhòu, tā běnlái xiǎng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: The first time she went to the orphanage, what did she plan to do?

choices.english: Teach the children to brush their teeth.
Teach the children to get dressed.

questions.why: 第一次去的時候，我想教孩子唱歌: her first plan was a song. Playing first was the teacher's advice for later visits, and tooth-brushing and dressing came after that.

prompt.traditional: 她從這些經驗中知道了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 她从这些经验中知道了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tā cóng zhèxiē jīngyàn zhōng zhīdào le shénme?
prompt.english: What did she learn from these experiences?

choices.pinyin: Jiāo háizi yào yuè zǎo yuè hǎo.
choices.english: The earlier you teach children, the better.

choices.pinyin: Kèběn néng jiāo wǒmen hěn duō.
Yào xiān ràng háizi xǐhuān zìjǐ.
choices.english: First get the children to like you.

questions.why: 從這些經驗中，我知道了……得先讓他們喜歡你: to be listened to, first make them like you. She says this is something textbooks can't teach, and the passage says nothing about singing making children happy or starting early.

text.traditional: 我家附近的便利商店最近在辦活動：買滿五十塊就送一張貼紙，貼紙滿十張，就可以換一個卡通娃娃。我妹妹很喜愛那個娃娃，為了得到它，她每天早上都去買豆漿和麵包，有時候連不需要的東西也買。一個星期以後，她已經有八張了，可是店員說，娃娃已經換光了，她難過得哭了。我只好上網買了一個一樣的娃娃送給她。我覺得商人很了解顧客的心理，像這樣的活動，連我這種不喜歡卡通的人都覺得很有吸引力。
text.simplified: 我家附近的便利商店最近在办活动：买满五十块就送一张贴纸，贴纸满十张，就可以换一个卡通娃娃。我妹妹很喜爱那个娃娃，为了得到它，她每天早上都去买豆浆和面包，有时候连不需要的东西也买。一个星期以后，她已经有八张了，可是店员说，娃娃已经换光了，她难过得哭了。我只好上网买了一个一样的娃娃送给她。我觉得商人很了解顾客的心理，像这样的活动，连我这种不喜欢卡通的人都觉得很有吸引力。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn de biànlì shāngdiàn zuìjìn zài bàn huódòng: mǎi mǎn wǔshí kuài jiù sòng yì zhāng tiēzhǐ, tiēzhǐ mǎn shí zhāng, jiù kěyǐ huàn yí ge kǎtōng wáwa. Wǒ mèimei hěn xǐ'ài nàge wáwa, wèile dédào tā, tā měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù mǎi dòujiāng hé miànbāo, yǒu shíhòu lián bù xūyào de dōngxi yě mǎi. Yí ge xīngqí yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng yǒu bā zhāng le, kěshì diànyuán shuō, wáwa yǐjīng huàn guāng le, tā nánguò de kū le. Wǒ zhǐhǎo shàngwǎng mǎi le yí ge yíyàng de wáwa sòng gěi tā. Wǒ juéde shāngrén hěn liǎojiě gùkè de xīnlǐ, xiàng zhèyàng de huódòng, lián wǒ zhè zhǒng bù xǐhuān kǎtōng de rén dōu juéde hěn yǒu xīyǐnlì.
text.english: The convenience store near my home is running a promotion: spend fifty dollars and you get a sticker, and once you have a full ten stickers you can get a cartoon doll. My younger sister loves that doll. To get it she went every morning to buy soy milk and bread, and sometimes even bought things she didn't need. A week later she already had eight, but the clerk said the dolls were all gone, and she was so sad she cried. I had no choice but to buy the same doll online and give it to her. I think business people understand customers' psychology very well: a promotion like this is attractive even to someone like me who doesn't like cartoons.

prompt.traditional: 一個星期以後，妹妹還差幾張貼紙？
prompt.simplified: 一个星期以后，妹妹还差几张贴纸？
prompt.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqí yǐhòu, mèimei hái chà jǐ zhāng tiēzhǐ?
prompt.english: After a week, how many more stickers did the sister need?

questions.why: 貼紙滿十張 gets a doll and she already had eight (已經有八張了), so she was two short. Eight is what she had and ten what she needed.

prompt.traditional: 妹妹為什麼哭了？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹为什么哭了？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei wèishénme kū le?
prompt.english: Why did the younger sister cry?

choices.english: The clerk wouldn't give her stickers.

choices.pinyin: Tā mǎi le bù xūyào de dōngxi.
choices.english: She had bought things she didn't need.

questions.why: 店員說，娃娃已經換光了: all the dolls had been taken, so she cried. She got her stickers and loved the doll, and buying things she didn't need is not why she cried.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人覺得這種活動怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人觉得这种活动怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén juéde zhè zhǒng huódòng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the writer think of this kind of promotion?

choices.pinyin: Sòng de tiēzhǐ bú gòu duō.

text.traditional: 上個星期五晚上，期末考考完了，我跟室友去KTV唱歌。我們選了學校附近的一家，因為那家是吃到飽的，除了唱歌，還可以吃各式各樣的小吃。我一直覺得自己唱歌不好聽，所以一開始只吃東西，不敢唱歌。後來室友點了一首我最拿手的歌，我就越來越興奮了。最後機器給我打了九十八分，室友都說我唱歌像歌星一樣好聽。我們一直唱歌，到半夜一點才回宿舍。可是第二天早上起來，因為前一天一直唱歌，我連一句話都說不出來了。
text.simplified: 上个星期五晚上，期末考考完了，我跟室友去KTV唱歌。我们选了学校附近的一家，因为那家是吃到饱的，除了唱歌，还可以吃各式各样的小吃。我一直觉得自己唱歌不好听，所以一开始只吃东西，不敢唱歌。后来室友点了一首我最拿手的歌，我就越来越兴奋了。最后机器给我打了九十八分，室友都说我唱歌像歌星一样好听。我们一直唱歌，到半夜一点才回宿舍。可是第二天早上起来，因为前一天一直唱歌，我连一句话都说不出来了。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng, qímòkǎo kǎo wán le, wǒ gēn shìyǒu qù KTV chànggē. Wǒmen xuǎn le xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā, yīnwèi nà jiā shì chīdàobǎo de, chúle chànggē, hái kěyǐ chī gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī. Wǒ yìzhí juéde zìjǐ chànggē bù hǎotīng, suǒyǐ yìkāishǐ zhǐ chī dōngxi, bù gǎn chànggē. Hòulái shìyǒu diǎn le yì shǒu wǒ zuì náshǒu de gē, wǒ jiù yuèláiyuè xīngfèn le. Zuìhòu jīqì gěi wǒ dǎ le jiǔshíbā fēn, shìyǒu dōu shuō wǒ chànggē xiàng gēxīng yíyàng hǎotīng. Wǒmen yìzhí chànggē, dào bànyè yì diǎn cái huí sùshè. Kěshì dì èr tiān zǎoshàng qǐlái, yīnwèi qián yì tiān yìzhí chànggē, wǒ lián yí jù huà dōu shuō bù chūlái le.
text.english: Last Friday evening, with finals over, my roommate and I went to sing at a KTV. We chose one near school, because it's all-you-can-eat: besides singing you can eat all kinds of snacks. I've always thought I sing badly, so at first I only ate and didn't dare to sing. Then my roommate picked the song I sing best, and I got more and more excited. In the end the machine gave me 98 points, and my roommates said I sounded as good as a pop star. We kept singing until one in the morning before going back to the dorm. But when I got up the next morning, after singing nonstop the night before, I couldn't say a single word.
